text: EX-99.1 2 exhibit991-10302026.htm PRESS RELEASE Document Exhibit 99.1 November 18, 2026 For 6:00 a.m. ET Release LOWE’S REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 SALES AND EARNINGS RESULTS — Diluted EPS of $2.98; Adjusted Diluted EPS 1 of $3.10 — — Total Sales Increased 9.3% — — Comparable Sales Increased 1.8% — — Updates Full Year 2026 Outlook — MOORESVILLE, N.C., November 18, 2026 – Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) today reported net earnings of $1.7 billion and diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $2.98 for the quarter ended October 30, 2026, compared to diluted EPS of $2.88 in the third quarter of 2025. During the third quarter ended October 30, 2026, the company recognized $96 million in pre-tax expenses associated with acquisition-related intangible asset amortization for Foundation Building Materials (FBM) and Artisan Design Group (ADG). Excluding these expenses, third quarte r 2026 adju sted diluted EPS 1 increased 1.3% to $3.10 compared to the prior-year adjusted diluted EPS. The company also recognized a positive pre-tax impact of approximately $250 million associated with IEEPA tariff refunds. Both diluted EPS and adjusted diluted EPS 1 include a $0.34 positive impact from IEEPA tariff refunds. Total sales for the quarter were $22.8 billion, compared to $20.8 billion in the prior-year quarter. Comparable sales for the quarter increased 1.8%, driven by a 17.4% increase in online sales as well as solid performance in Pro and home services sales. “We just delivered our sixth consecutive quarter of positive comp sales driven by continued growth across Pro, Online and Home Services. These results reflect the resiliency of our Total Home strategy,” said Marvin R. Ellison, Lowe’s chairman, president and CEO. “We remain confident in our agile business model and look forward to sharing more about our growth opportunities in December at our Analyst and Investor Conference. I would also like to thank our frontline associates for their dedication to serve our customers by solving problems and fulfilling dreams for their homes.” As of October 30, 2026, Lowe’s operated 1,762 stores, representing 197.0 million square feet of retail selling space. Capital Allocation The company remains committed to generating sustainable shareholder value through a disciplined focus on its capital allocation program. During the quarter, the company paid $701 million in dividends and maintained its status as a Dividend Aristocrat and Dividend King. 1 Adjusted diluted earnings per share is a non-GAAP financial measure. Refer to the “Non-GAAP Financial Measures Reconciliation” section of this release for additional information, as well as reconciliations between the company’s GAAP and non-GAAP financial results. Lowe’s Business Outlook The company is updating its outlook for fiscal year 2026 to reflect operational results for the first three quarters of the year as well as current demand trends and cost pressures across the business. Fiscal Year 2026 Outlook • Total sales of approximately $92.5 billion (previously $92.0 billion) • Comparable sales expected to be up approximately +0.5% compared to prior year (previously flat) • Operating income as a percentage of sales (operating margin) of approximately 11.1% (previously 11.2%) • Adjusted 1 operating income as a percentage of sales (adjusted operating margin) of approximately 11.5% (previously 11.6%) • Net interest expense of approximately $1.5 billion (previously $1.6 billion) • Effective income tax rate of approximately 24.5% • Diluted earnings per share of approximately $11.75 • Adjusted 1 diluted earnings per share of approximately $12.25 • Capital expenditures of up to $2.5 billion A conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 operating results is scheduled for today, Wednesday, November 18, at 9 a.m. ET. The conference call will be available by webcast and can be accessed by visiting Lowe’s website at ir.lowes.com and clicking on Lowe’s Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call Webcast. Supplemental slides will be available prior to the start of the conference call. A replay of the call will be archived at ir.lowes.com. Lowe’s Companies, Inc. Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion. Lowe's employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,750 home improvement stores, 540 branches and 120 distribution centers. Lowe’s is a core value S&P 500 equity stock, a dividend aristocrat and dividend king. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com. 1 Adjusted diluted earnings per share is a non-GAAP financial measure. Non-GAAP Financial Measure Reconciliation (Unaudited) To provide additional transparency, the Company has presented the non-GAAP financial measure of adjusted diluted earnings per share for the three months ended October 30, 2026 and October 31, 2025. This measure excludes the impact of certain items, further described below, to assist analysts and investors in understanding operational performance for the third quarter of fiscal 2026. Fiscal 2026 Impacts During fiscal 2026, the Company recognized financial impacts from the following: • In the third quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company recognized pre-tax expenses of $96 million consisting of intangible asset amortization related to the acquisitions of Artisan Design Group and Foundation Building Materials (Acquisitions of businesses). Fiscal 2025 Impacts During fiscal 2025, the Company recognized financial impacts from the following: • In the third quarter of fiscal 2025, the Company recognized pre-tax expenses of $129 million consisting of transaction costs and intangible asset amortization related to the acquisitions of Artisan Design Group and Foundation Building Materials (Acquisitions of businesses). In addition, the Company has provided full year fiscal 2026 guidance of the non-GAAP financial measures adjusted operating margin and adjusted diluted earnings per share, which exclude the impact of intangible asset amortization, and related tax effects if applicable, related to the acquisitions of Foundation Building Materials and Artisan Design Group. When evaluated with our GAAP results, we believe these non-GAAP measures provide investors with meaningful measures of comparable performance. Adjusted operating margin and adjusted diluted earnings per share should not be considered an alternative to, or more meaningful indicator of, the Company’s operating margin or diluted earnings per share as prepared in accordance with GAAP. The Company’s methods of determining non-GAAP financial measures may differ from the method used by other companies and may not be comparable.
